title: mammillaria thornberi subsp. yaquensis
intro: Mammillaria thornberi subsp. yaquensis, commonly known as Yaqui Pincushion, is a cactus species native to Mexico. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Yaqui Pincushion include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms and its potential to protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that have been reported to exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
